notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
The first patch has been released and includes changes to:
-        fixed the phrase in all endings about the fact that the treasure of the necromancer Ikaros has not yet been found. One of the adventurers found the treasure and notified the developers
-        fixed a few bugs in the text
-        replaced some CG background images
-        replaced some sprites - edited light and shadows
